summary: Finding the right page is quicker with six grouped menus.

new.title: Six clear menus instead of sixteen tabs
new.text: Pages are grouped in six menus: Overview, Tagging, Conditional Access, Identity report, Jobs & runs and Administration. Each page has one line on what it is for.

new.title: Easier-to-read product name in the header
new.text: The full name next to EPS in the header is now light and easy to read.
